Search WCVP Backbone for a Scientific Name

dot-check_wcvp_synonymy_candidates.Rd

Find Internal Backbone Taxa That Share the Same WCVP Accepted Name

Usage

.check_wcvp_synonymy_candidates(plant_name_id, con_taxa)

Arguments

plant_name_id

Integer. WCVP plant_name_id of the matched taxon.

con_taxa

Database connection (or Pool) to the taxa database.

Value

A data frame with columns idtax_n, plant_name_id, wcvp_name, taxon_status, taxon_authors, match_type, tax_gen, tax_esp, tax_fam, tax_rank01, tax_nam01, idtax_good_n, or an empty data frame on error / no matches.

Details

Given a plant_name_id from wcvp_names, retrieves all other WCVP entries that share the same accepted_plant_name_id and are already linked to internal backbone taxa via wcvp_idtax_link. These are potential synonyms of the taxon being added.
